reason: I already have an AirTag and it does the 'where is he' part for almost nothing. $249 plus $20 a month for video I'd rarely open is a lot to pay for something I'm not sure we'd use every day.
objection: An AirTag or a kids' watch does most of this for much less, and I'd have to pay a monthly fee forever just to keep the live video working.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial or a month-to-month option with no monthly plan required, plus proof that the live video and SOS alert really work from a wandering-prone wearer's device without a long setup.
